pages.quiz:
AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is a fuel? (1 mark)
   A. A kind of food
   B. A cleaning tool
   C. A type of soil
   D. Something we burn to get heat

2. How should broken glass be disposed of? (1 mark)
   A. Left on the floor
   B. Put in the compost
   C. Wrapped in thick paper and given to an adult
   D. Thrown in the yard

3. What is personal hygiene? (1 mark)
   A. Washing cars
   B. Cooking food
   C. Keeping our own bodies clean to stay healthy
   D. Cleaning the compound

4. When should you wash your hands? (1 mark)
   A. Only after school ends
   B. Before eating and after using the toilet
   C. Never
   D. Only on Sunday

5. Why do we dust from high places to low places? (1 mark)
   A. High places are easier
   B. Low places are dirtier
   C. Dust falls downward
   D. It looks better

6. What should you do before you start cooking? (1 mark)
   A. Play with the fire
   B. Wash your hands
   C. Eat first
   D. Take off your shoes

7. Which animal is a domestic animal, not a wild one? (1 mark)
   A. Monkey
   B. Goat
   C. Squirrel
   D. Hare

8. Which of these helps to prevent soil erosion? (1 mark)
   A. Burning the soil
   B. Covering the ground with mulch or grass
   C. Digging up all the plants
   D. Leaving the ground bare

9. Should you share a toothbrush? (1 mark)
   A. Yes with friends
   B. No
   C. Yes with family
   D. Only at school

10. Why are diseased plants not added to compost? (1 mark)
   A. They rot too slowly to count
   B. The disease can spread to the crops later
   C. They make the heap too tall
   D. They are too heavy

11. Which is a benefit of compost to sandy soil? (1 mark)
   A. It makes the soil disappear
   B. It helps the soil to hold water
   C. It makes the soil more sandy
   D. It removes all nutrients

12. Why do we soak dry beans before cooking? (1 mark)
   A. They become poisonous
   B. They dry out
   C. They become bigger than the pot
   D. They cook in less time so less fuel is used

13. Which of these crops can be watered with drip irrigation? (1 mark)
   A. Nothing at all
   B. Only crops under water
   C. Tomatoes in rows
   D. Only trees in forests

14. Why do children need an adult when cooking? (1 mark)
   A. Fuels and fire can burn people
   B. Children cannot lift a spoon
   C. Fire is not dangerous
   D. Adults always cook faster

15. What might happen if the water for a drip system is dirty? (1 mark)
   A. The water will taste better
   B. The bucket will be lighter
   C. The plants will grow faster
   D. The holes may block

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Explain the meaning of personal hygiene. (2 marks)

17. Plan a class display of cleaned PPE. Say what you would show and what information cards you would write. (5 marks)

18. Explain how domestic animals contribute to food production in a community. (5 marks)

19. Give three mistakes to avoid when sowing tiny seeds. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — Something we burn to get heat
   Fuels such as wood and gas are burnt for heat.

2. C — Wrapped in thick paper and given to an adult
   This prevents cuts.

3. C — Keeping our own bodies clean to stay healthy
   Personal hygiene is care of the body.

4. B — Before eating and after using the toilet
   These are key times.

5. C — Dust falls downward
   Dust moves downward.

6. B — Wash your hands
   Clean hands prevent germs.

7. B — Goat
   Goats are kept by people.

8. B — Covering the ground with mulch or grass
   Covering keeps rain from washing soil away.

9. B — No
   Toothbrushes carry germs.

10. B — The disease can spread to the crops later
   Disease germs may survive and infect crops when the compost is used.

11. B — It helps the soil to hold water
   Compost holds water like a sponge.

12. D — They cook in less time so less fuel is used
   Soaked beans soften and cook faster.

13. C — Tomatoes in rows
   Drip systems suit row crops such as tomatoes and kale.

14. A — Fuels and fire can burn people
   Adults can guide and help prevent accidents.

15. D — The holes may block
   Dirt gets stuck in tiny holes.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: Keeping our own body clean to stay healthy.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for keeping clean, 1 mark for health.

17. (5 marks)
   Answer: Display gloves, gumboots, mask, headgear, overall, canvas shoes; cards say what each protects and how to clean it; safe storage; explain to visitors.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for items, 2 marks for cards, 1 mark for explaining.

18. (5 marks)
   Answer: They give milk, eggs and meat directly; their manure and draught power help to grow crops; and money from sales can buy other foods.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for direct food, 2 for crops, 1 for income.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: Leaving big lumps in the seedbed, sowing too deep, sowing too thick without thinning, or watering strongly (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each mistake.
